title: Warehouse Operations Manager
description:
**Warehouse Operations Manager** 




**Company:** 
 Mishtighar
 



**Industry:** 
 FMCG / D2C
 



**Location:** 
 Kolkata, West Bengal
 



**Experience:** 
 5\+ Years
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Department:** 
 Supply Chain \& Operations
 



**About Mishtighar** 




**Mishtighar is an FMCG D2C brand focused on delivering high\-quality food products to customers through ecommerce channels. As we continue to scale, we are looking for an experienced Warehouse Operations Manager** 
 to take ownership of our end\-to\-end warehouse and fulfilment operations in Kolkata.
 



**Role Overview** 




**We are looking for a hands\-on and process\-driven Warehouse Operations Manager** 
 who can independently manage the day\-to\-day functioning of the warehouse while ensuring high standards of inventory accuracy, order fulfilment, dispatch efficiency, hygiene, safety and manpower productivity.
 



 The ideal candidate should have
 **5\+ years of relevant experience in warehouse operations, FMCG, D2C, e\-commerce** 
 , with strong experience in managing teams and high\-volume inventory movement.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. End\-to\-End Warehouse Operations** 



* Manage complete warehouse operations including
 **inward, receiving, GRN, put\-away, storage, picking, packing, dispatch and returns** 
 .
* Ensure smooth and timely movement of inventory across all warehouse processes.
* Maintain proper warehouse layout, binning, SKU identification and space utilisation.
* Ensure adherence to defined SOPs and operational processes.



**2\. Inventory Management \& Control** 



* Maintain high inventory accuracy through regular
 **cycle counts, physical stock audits and reconciliation** 
 .
* Monitor stock levels, ageing, damages, shortages, excess inventory and discrepancies.
* Ensure proper
 **FIFO/FEFO** 
 practices, particularly for food and FMCG products.
* Investigate inventory mismatches and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Maintain accurate records of SKU\-wise and batch\-wise inventory.



**3\. D2C Order Fulfilment \& Dispatch** 



* Ensure timely processing and dispatch of D2C, marketplace and other customer orders.
* Monitor daily order volumes, pending orders, dispatch TAT and fulfilment accuracy.
* Coordinate with courier and logistics partners to ensure smooth handover and timely movement of shipments.
* Monitor
 **RTOs, returns, replacements, damages and delivery\-related discrepancies** 
 .
* Ensure peak\-period and promotional\-sale readiness.



**4\. Team \& Manpower Management** 



* Lead, train and supervise warehouse executives, supervisors, pickers, packers, loaders and other warehouse staff.
* Allocate daily responsibilities and monitor manpower productivity.
* Manage attendance, shift planning, discipline and performance.
* Ensure the team follows warehouse SOPs, safety standards and hygiene practices.



**5\. Logistics \& Vendor Coordination** 



* Coordinate with courier partners, transporters, 3PL partners and other logistics vendors.
* Monitor vendor performance, service levels and operational issues.
* Resolve delays, shortages, damages and shipment\-related escalations.
* Ensure timely vehicle planning, loading and dispatch wherever applicable.



**6\. MIS \& Performance Monitoring** 



* Prepare and maintain daily, weekly and monthly warehouse MIS.
* Track key operational KPIs such as:
* Inventory accuracy
* Order fulfilment accuracy
* Dispatch TAT
* Picking \& packing productivity
* Stock variance
* Damage/shortage percentage
* RTO and return rates
* Manpower productivity
* Analyse operational data and identify areas for improvement.



**7\. Process Improvement \& Cost Optimisation** 



* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement process improvements.
* Improve warehouse productivity, space utilisation and manpower efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to reduce wastage, damages, inventory loss and operational costs.
* Develop and implement effective warehouse SOPs as the business scales.



**8\. Hygiene, Safety \& Compliance** 



* Maintain high standards of warehouse hygiene, cleanliness and safety.
* Ensure appropriate storage and handling of FMCG/food products.
* Maintain proper documentation and support internal/external stock audits.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and applicable warehouse/food\-handling requirements.



**Requirements** 



* **5\+ years of relevant experience** 
 in warehouse management, warehouse operations, FMCG, D2C, e\-commerce, retail, distribution or 3PL.
* Prior experience in
 **FMCG/food/D2C/e\-commerce warehouse operations** 
 will be preferred.
* Graduate in any discipline; qualification in
 **Supply Chain, Logistics or Operations** 
 is an advantage.
* Strong understanding of inventory management, stock reconciliation, inward/outward processes, picking, packing and dispatch.
* Experience in managing and supervising warehouse teams.
* Working knowledge of
 **WMS/ERP/inventory management systems** 
 .
* Strong proficiency in
 **MS Excel/Google Sheets and MIS reporting** 
 .
* Strong organisational, analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent coordination and communication skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, growing D2C environment and take complete ownership of warehouse operations.

title: Production Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 EDCONS EXPORTS PVT. LTD. combines Italian design expertise with over 30 years of Indian craftsmanship to produce premium leather goods and fashion accessories. From its headquarters in Kolkata and a Milan\-based design studio, the company serves leading global brands with handbags, wallets, and small leather goods. A 200,000 sq. ft factory manages cutting, stitching, finishing, quality control, and packaging entirely in\-house, supporting both large\-scale production and custom, small\-batch orders. Recognized as a Government of India Star Export House and certified by BSCI, Sedex, and ISO 14001, EDCONS is committed to ethical labor, safe workplaces, and environmentally responsible manufacturing. The company exports to clients across Europe, the United States, and Asia, offering dependable quality, sustainability, and traceability in leather goods.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Production Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Greater Kolkata Area, responsible for overseeing end\-to\-end production operations for leather goods and fashion accessories. This role includes planning and scheduling production, managing shop\-floor activities, monitoring output against targets, and coordinating cutting, stitching, finishing, and packaging functions. The Production Manager will lead and guide production teams, ensure adherence to quality standards and compliance requirements, and maintain workplace safety and efficiency. Daily activities involve collaborating with design, sourcing, and quality assurance teams, optimizing resource utilization, solving production bottlenecks, and maintaining accurate documentation and reports. The role also requires continuous improvement of processes to support on\-time delivery, cost control, and scalability for both bulk and custom orders.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong production planning, workflow management, and capacity planning skills, with experience in high\-volume manufacturing environments.
* Hands\-on experience in leather goods, apparel, or accessories production processes, including cutting, stitching, finishing, and packaging.
* Proficiency in quality control methods, process standardization, and compliance with social and environmental standards.
* Leadership and team management skills, including training, performance monitoring, and cross\-functional coordination.
* Ability to analyze production data, use basic ERP or manufacturing software, and prepare clear reports and dashboards.
* Strong problem\-solving, decision\-making, and organizational skills, with attention to detail and time management.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English; knowledge of local languages is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Production Management, Industrial Engineering, Operations, or a related field; relevant experience in export\-oriented manufacturing is preferred.
* Familiarity with safety regulations, ethical labor practices, and sustainability\-oriented manufacturing will be beneficial.

title: Marketplace Manager
description:
We're looking for a Marketplace Manager to own Eyemode's presence and performance on Amazon and Myntra. This is a high\-ownership, hands\-on role for someone who wants to build a marketplace function from the ground up at a fast\-growing brand.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities

* Lead onboarding onto new categories/sub\-brands within these platforms, including approvals and catalog setup

* 1\-2 years of experience in marketplace/e\-commerce management, ideally in fashion, lifestyle, D2C, or eyewear
* Hands\-on experience with both Amazon Seller Central and Myntra Partner Portal
* Strong grip on Amazon Ads and Myntra Ads, plus unit economics/P\&L thinking
* Comfortable with data — Excel/Sheets fluency, and ability to pull insights from platform dashboards

 We are seeking an innovative and results\-driven leader to serve as VP, IAM Assurance Leader, responsible for leading the IAM Services Assurance function overseeing key controls across all centralized and decentralized IAM services. This role will work closely with IAM product owners and engineering teams to ensure adherence to Synchrony IAM standards and regulatory requirements without disrupting operational delivery.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise and hands\-on experience across IAM controls, assurance operations, and identity/authentication platforms (e.g., Active Directory, LDAP technologies, Beyond Identity, and related IAM services). As a strategic leader, you will guide teams, enable cross\-functional collaboration, and drive continuous improvement in the effectiveness, reporting, and automation of IAM controls—particularly in critical areas such as logical access, authentication assurance, privileged access oversight, and control evidence for SOX/PCI and other regulatory obligations. You will blend technology insight with program management discipline to ensure success in execution and delivery, including the creation and modernization of assurance reporting capabilities and the automation of control remediation where appropriate.
   

  

**Essential Responsibilities**
* Create and Maintain Strategic Roadmaps: Develop and execute multi\-year roadmaps to drive innovation, strengthen security posture, meet regulatory requirements, and streamline IAM operations—specifically for IAM assurance capabilities, control monitoring, and evidence automation.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Build and nurture strong relationships across Security Operations, Technology Teams, Governance, Operational Risk, and Internal Audit, ensuring program alignment, audit readiness, and the ability to clearly demonstrate IAM control effectiveness to stakeholders and regulators.
* Risk and Progress Management: Identify, assess, and mitigate technical and organizational risks while regularly reporting blockers, corrective actions, and program milestones to executive leadership; ensure timely remediation of control gaps and recurring defects.
* Solution Design \& Automation: Lead and contribute to designing technical solutions for complex automation use cases, driving operational efficiency and scalability—especially automation to detect, track, and remediate IAM control defects.
* Program Integrity: Ensure standards, policies, and procedures are accurately documented and officially maintained for audit and compliance requirements; recommend updates to IAM standards based on security threats, regulatory expectations, and industry trends.
* Performance Tracking: Define, implement, and monitor Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure program maturity and overall effectiveness, including assurance coverage, control pass rates, remediation SLAs, defect recurrence, and reporting timeliness/accuracy.
* Assurance Operations Leadership: Lead assurance activities to track, validate, and remediate key logical access and authentication controls across centralized IAM services (e.g., Active Directory, Oracle LDAP, Beyond Identity) and decentralized implementations as applicable.

 .

* Deep command of district and counter\-level execution and counter\-share gain.
* A leader who builds teams and the next line of leaders, and runs on data and a clear review cadence.
* For East \& NE, a strong track record in the eastern market and the ability to drive the West Bengal 2X model.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* Experience operating under a unified national market framework.

**Pay range and compensation package** 




  





 As per the Industry.

* The Regional VP runs a region of steel sales end to end: the P\&L, the Zonal Heads, and the district and counter execution that turns strategy into share.
* All four regions run under one national market framework, so growth is comparable, disciplined and margin\-led rather than a set of local styles.

* Every region operates on the same three pillars, under one scope.

 We are looking for an experienced and execution\-driven
 **Restaurant Onboarding Manager** 
 to lead Gintaa’s restaurant acquisition and onboarding operations.
 



 The role will be responsible for identifying and acquiring high\-potential restaurant partners, managing commercial discussions, ensuring documentation and onboarding completion, coordinating menu and catalogue setup, driving restaurant activation, and ensuring that newly onboarded restaurants become successfully operational on the Gintaa platform.
 



 The ideal candidate must have
 **5–7 years of hands\-on experience specifically in restaurant onboarding, restaurant acquisition, merchant acquisition, food\-tech partnerships, or restaurant account management within the online food delivery ecosystem.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Restaurant Acquisition \& Market Expansion
 


* Own restaurant acquisition and onboarding targets across assigned territories, zones, and markets.
* Identify high\-potential restaurants, QSRs, cloud kitchens, local food brands, restaurant chains, and strategic merchant partners.
* Develop market\-level acquisition strategies based on cuisine gaps, customer demand, locality coverage, pricing, and restaurant popularity.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective restaurant partners.
* Conduct regular market mapping and identify restaurants currently missing from Gintaa's portfolio.
* Drive both field\-based and strategic restaurant acquisition initiatives.
* Support Gintaa's expansion into new locations by rapidly developing the restaurant supply base.



  





 2\. Restaurant Onboarding
 


* Manage the complete restaurant onboarding lifecycle from initial contact to successful activation.
* Coordinate collection and verification of required restaurant information and documentation.
* Ensure restaurant profiles, menus, pricing, operating hours, images, bank details, tax information, and other required information are accurately captured.
* Coordinate internally for account creation and platform configuration.
* Ensure onboarding activities are completed within defined turnaround times.
* Maintain high onboarding quality and minimize errors that could affect restaurant operations or customer experience.



  





 3\. Commercial Negotiation \& Partner Conversion
 


* Conduct commercial discussions with restaurant owners, decision\-makers, and management teams.
* Clearly communicate Gintaa's value proposition and partnership model.
* Negotiate commercials and partnership terms within approved company guidelines.
* Handle objections and competitive comparisons effectively.
* Drive conversion of qualified restaurant leads into active partners.
* Maintain transparency in all commercial commitments made to restaurant partners.



  





 4\. Restaurant Activation \& Go\-Live
 


* Own the journey from
 **Lead → Meeting → Agreement → Documentation → Menu Setup → Onboarding → Go\-Live → First Order** 
 .
* Ensure newly onboarded restaurants become operational within the defined activation timeline.
* Coordinate with restaurant partners to resolve issues delaying activation.
* Track restaurants that have completed onboarding but have not gone live or received orders.
* Drive activation and first\-order completion for newly onboarded partners.
* Ensure restaurant partners understand the operational workflow before going live.



  





 5\. Menu \& Catalogue Readiness
 


* Ensure restaurant menus are accurately represented on the Gintaa platform.
* Coordinate menu collection, item categorization, pricing, descriptions, images, availability, add\-ons, and customization requirements.
* Ensure restaurant information including address, operating hours, cuisines, and contact details is accurate.
* Work closely with catalogue/content teams to minimize menu\-related errors.
* Coordinate with restaurant partners for timely menu updates whenever required.



  





 6\. Partner Training \& Operational Readiness
 


* Educate newly onboarded restaurant partners on order acceptance and management processes.
* Explain platform workflows, restaurant responsibilities, delivery coordination, cancellations, customer issues, and escalation procedures.
* Ensure restaurant staff understand how to efficiently manage online orders.
* Provide initial operational support during the restaurant's launch phase.
* Reduce early\-stage operational issues through effective onboarding and training.



  





 7\. Restaurant Partner Relationship Management
 


* Build strong working relationships with restaurant owners and key decision\-makers.
* Act as an escalation point during the initial onboarding and activation period.
* Understand restaurant partner concerns and coordinate internally for resolution.
* Maintain high levels of partner satisfaction throughout the onboarding journey.
* Ensure smooth handover of successfully activated restaurants to the relevant account management or restaurant operations team.



  





 8\. Team Management \& Leadership
 


* Lead and mentor Restaurant Acquisition Managers, Onboarding Executives, Business Development Executives, and field teams.
* Allocate territories and acquisition targets based on market potential.
* Conduct daily and weekly pipeline reviews with the team.
* Track individual and team\-level performance against defined targets.
* Coach team members on pitching, negotiation, objection handling, and restaurant conversion.
* Build a high\-performance culture focused on acquisition quality, speed, ownership, and execution.



  





 9\. Market Intelligence \& Competition Tracking
 


* Maintain strong awareness of the local restaurant and food delivery ecosystem.
* Track competitor restaurant partnerships, market penetration, restaurant offers, and acquisition activities.
* Gather structured feedback from restaurant partners regarding market trends and competitor propositions.
* Identify cuisine, pricing, locality, and restaurant\-selection gaps in Gintaa's marketplace.
* Share actionable market intelligence with business leadership.



  





 10\. Cross\-Functional Coordination
 



 Work closely with:
 


* Restaurant Operations
* Catalogue/Menu Management
* Sales \& Business Development
* Finance
* Legal/Compliance
* Customer Support
* Delivery Operations
* Product \& Technology
* Marketing



  





 Ensure smooth movement of restaurant partners across the entire acquisition, onboarding, activation, and operational handover journey.
 



 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 



 Performance for this role will primarily be measured through:
 


* Number of Restaurants Acquired
* Qualified Lead\-to\-Onboarding Conversion %
* Restaurants Onboarded per Month
* Restaurant Activation / Go\-Live Rate
* Average Onboarding TAT
* Documentation Completion Rate
* Menu/Listing Accuracy
* Agreement\-to\-Go\-Live TAT
* Onboarding\-to\-First\-Order Conversion
* Restaurant Partner Drop\-Off Rate
* Acquisition Cost per Restaurant
* Restaurant Coverage by Zone
* Target vs. Achievement
* Team Productivity
* Restaurant Partner Satisfaction



  





 Required Experience \& Qualifications
 


* **5–7 years of relevant professional experience.**
* **Prior experience in the same domain – restaurant acquisition, restaurant onboarding, food\-tech merchant acquisition, or restaurant partnerships – is MANDATORY.**
* **Candidates without relevant restaurant/food\-delivery onboarding or acquisition experience will not be considered for this position.**
* **Proven experience working directly with restaurant owners, restaurant chains, QSRs, cloud kitchens, or food\-service businesses.**
* **Strong experience in restaurant acquisition, onboarding, activation, and commercial negotiations.**

* **Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, CRM systems, MIS reporting, and performance dashboards.**
